title: HtmlSelect
responsibility: Renders the native select element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlSelect.children
inputs.description: Optional content rendered inside the native select element only when it is provided; omitting it leaves the select with no content. The component does not validate the content, so native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlSelect
outputs.description: The native select element itself, with the fixed tag select, every prop other than children spread onto it, and the children content inside it, with no wrapper element around it.
